name: AudigentBot
description: The broader of the two crawlers Audigent documents on its bot page. Unlike AudigentAdBot, which reads only HTML head metadata, Audigent states that AudigentBot can scrape any content available on the page, from both the header and the body, and that it can be blocked with a wildcard robots.txt rule. Audigent says it crawls only sites where it or its advertiser partners may serve ads.
